findings.title: Expired spending leases can restart without the required checkpoint
findings.detail: FIXED. The takeover guard rejects JOB_ATTEMPT and MODEL_TASK leases that never stored a checkpoint and requires exact checkpoint equality. claim_lease checks expiry before the owner branch at line 260; every expired claim, including the former owner's, advances the fence at line 280. Checked adapter regressions at packages/persistence/test/adapters-leases.test.ts:123 and :158, plus direct SQL enforcement at packages/persistence/test/journals-leases.test.ts:332. All three pass in verify.log.
findings.reproduction: The regressions reproduce both earlier paths: another owner claiming an expired checkpoint-free spending lease, and the original owner claiming after expiry with a missing or incorrect checkpoint. Both now return REFUSED RESUME_WITHOUT_CHECKPOINT without changing the row. A valid stored checkpoint resumes under fence 2 and fences out fence 1.

findings.title: ApprovePlan accepts sources whose retention has already expired
findings.detail: FIXED. ApprovePlan rejects null source availability. packages/persistence/src/repositories/workspace.ts:327 computes availability after the revision transition lock using ACTIVE retention records with effective_deadline > kauro.server_now(), matching the existing availability reader. Checked apps/api/test/cmd025-approve-plan.test.ts:240: the independent oracle confirms SEALED state and lapsed retention; the route returns SOURCE_EXPIRED with no approval, event or journal, while a current source succeeds. The positive test at line 73 also independently verifies future retention. Both pass in verify.log.
findings.reproduction: The new regression creates a source sealed fifteen days earlier and leaves its governing retention record ACTIVE without running the sweeper. Approval now returns 422 SOURCE_EXPIRED and leaves the plan VALIDATED v4. The same approval flow on a source sealed an hour earlier returns 201.
